name: ModelVariant817_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant817_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (every period a jagged bolt is strung between a model point and a jittered point on the opposing slot, drawn as sprites with two layers of Gouraud strands; each finished bolt flashes the screen and throws off animated burst and smoke sprites, while a glow on the model point sheds fading line sparks and the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt strands and sparks and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the spark end time, 4 once as each bolt finishes, 1 once with a last flash after the final bolt, 2 once the end time has passed after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-834 and 931 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
